summary: On the main deck, the monitors suddenly glitch as though the Matrix had an electronic seizure. Seeing this, Tank reacts with alarm, exclaiming "Oh shit! Oh shit!"

what_changes.before: Working at his station, he registers something odd, asking "What is that...?"
what_changes.after: The glitch throws him into alarmed alarm, exclaiming "Oh shit!  Oh shit!"
what_changes.evidence: The monitors suddenly glitch as though the Matrix had an electronic seizure. TANK Oh shit!  Oh shit!

event_hint.one_line: The ship's monitors glitch, and Tank reacts with alarm.
